slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation) states that rural health centres, posts and huts record on paper registers and that their aggregate data is compiled and entered into the national DHIS2 at district or higher levels; the document gives no date for this, so its publication date is used.

Data Landscapers' review states that rural health centres, posts and huts predominantly record patient data in paper registers at the point of service, with no evidence of routine electronic records or point-of-care digital entry in most rural facilities; no date is given, so the publication date is used.
Data Landscapers' review states that electronic patient records were piloted in 2 hospitals (tier not stated), 1 health centre and 1 health post as of 2025, covering 127,000 patients.
Data Landscapers' review counts 1 health centre and 1 health post, beside 2 hospitals, as the pilot sites for electronic patient records as of 2025; it gives no denominator of primary clinics.

Data Landscapers' review states that the Programme de Digitalisation du Système de Santé (PDSS) targets 20% EMR adoption in health centres by end-2025; no date is given for the statement, so the publication date is used.

Data Landscapers' review describes the PDSS, the programme carrying the EMR target, as supported by the World Bank; no domestic budget line is stated and no date is given, so the publication date is used.
